verdict.rationale: Weave documents some built-in views over these metrics: per-call costs in the trace tree and calls table, evaluation comparison visualizations, org-shareable leaderboards that aggregate eval results, and vaguely described "native analytics tools." None of this amounts to a documented user-composable dashboard builder spanning latency, error, cost and eval scores. Missing for 10: a documented custom dashboard or panel builder, latency and error-rate charting, combined cross-metric dashboards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
